### Where it is available

The vendor states this explicitly: `global`.

> Wedge is Clay’s virtual GTM acceleration program for the fastest-growing, Series A and below venture-backed startups globally.

### Notes

Clay publishes no credit figure for Wedge — only "thousands of credits". The separate "Startup Partner Program" is for VC firms, accelerators, incubators and studios (not startups) and gives their portfolio "Automatic approval for Wedge". Clay's own discount FAQ lists only a 10% annual-plan discount and a 25% non-profit discount, i.e. no standing startup discount; a bespoke "Clay startup stipend" must be pitched for. The benefit is quoted as "Earn thousands of credits throughout the two week, live & async programs" - no dollar figure is published. "globally" is the vendor's own word, which is what supports the confirmed geography.
